_comment: Wilovan's INN register, gated on brothers_job_done (the close of a_gentlemans_disagreement). Attached ONLY to wilovan_inn_guest; the parlor hub (invrisil_wilovan) never rides along, so the commission, the three doors, Coyle, Farley, the marker and the fence shelf ALL stay in Invrisil, and no follow-up to that quest may appear here in any form. REGISTER-PURE for a Gentleman Caller also means the trade is never NAMED; Ratici is present only as 'my colleague'. Serve mirrors selys_inn/zevara_inn: {once_per_waking, item} sanctioned compound. Voice per docs/design/character-profiles.md: {addr} address (WIAddress resolves it per pc_gender -- never author a literal honorific at a PC), apology-before-courtesy.

greet.speaker: Wilovan
greet.text: {Addr}. A good evening to you, and a very good room to have it in. No business tonight, you'll be relieved to hear. A gentleman does occasionally sit somewhere nobody owes anybody anything.

text_variants.text: {Addr}. A good evening, and I'll say only that some evenings are quieter than others and the quiet ones are worth sitting in. This is one of them. The fire is the loudest thing in the room.

options.text: Bring him a bowl from the kitchen. (Serve)

offduty.speaker: Wilovan
offduty.text: None whatever, {addr}. My colleague is off attending an errand of the sort that keeps a man out past a decent hour, and I declined to attend it with him. A room where the fellow at the next table hasn't the first idea what I do, and no reason at all to ask, is a rare comfort. You'll note I've kept the hat on. No message in it tonight. It is, {addr}, simply a good hat.

options.text: Bring him a bowl from the kitchen. (Serve)
"Then keep the chair as long as you like."

served.speaker: Wilovan
served.text: That's very kind, {addr}, and I shan't spoil it by haggling. A man in my line gets offered a great many things and pays for most of them one way or another. This is neither. Hat off for it, plain and slow, and then straight back on before the stew goes cold.
